references.text: The next verse elaborates on Jesus' answer to the Pharisees: The kingdom of God does not come in a way that can be pointed out, for "the kingdom of God is among you" ([ref:Luk 17:21|Luke 17:21]).
The disciples thought that the kingdom of God was about to appear immediately, and Jesus told a parable to correct this expectation ([ref:Luk 19:11|Luke 19:11]).
Jesus tells Pilate that his kingdom is not of this world, which emphasizes that the kingdom of God does not come with outward, visible power as the Pharisees expected ([ref:Joh 18:36|John 18:36]).

Paul explains that the kingdom of God is not about food and drink, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit — thus the kingdom is not of an outward, observable nature ([ref:Rom 14:17|Romans 14:17]).
Jesus says that when he drives out demons by the finger of God, then the kingdom of God has come to them — the kingdom is already present in Jesus' work ([ref:Luk 11:20|Luke 11:20]).
The parable of the seed growing by itself illustrates that the kingdom of God comes in a hidden, invisible way, without humans being able to observe how it happens ([ref:Mark 4:26-29|Mark 4:26-29]).

Jesus says that the kingdom of God has already come to them because he drives out demons by the Spirit of God. This shows that the kingdom does not come with outward signs one can point to ([ref:Matt 12:28|Matthew 12:28]).

The disciples ask Jesus for signs about when the end times will come, and Jesus warns against following those who say "the time is near" — again a correction of the expectation of an observable, time-bound kingdom ([ref:Luk 21:7-8|Luke 21:7-8]).

The disciples ask if Jesus will now restore the kingdom for Israel, and Jesus answers that it is not their concern to know times or seasons — the coming of the kingdom is something humans cannot calculate ([ref:Apg 1:6-7|Acts 1:6-7]).

Paul writes that believers' lives are hidden with Christ in God. The kingdom of God is something hidden, inward, not something that can be observed with the naked eye ([ref:Kol 3:3-4|Colossians 3:3-4]).
